messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated error rate from cloud-kms client during signing (region=us-central1). Auto-page to on-call.

rachel: seeing massive init failures on new replicas — signer fails during boot waiting on KMS GetPublicKey/GetEncryptionKey. Startup stuck at `waiting for key` loop. Began ~2026-03-15T16:07:09Z.

mike: sample logs:```2026-03-15T16:07:11Z ERROR signer: kms call failed: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
2026-03-15T16:07:11Z ERROR pod: init failed, error retrieving key material
2026-03-15T16:07:12Z WARN signer: retrying (attempt=1) after=250ms```

deepti: Datadog metrics show p50 -> p95 jump and increased 5xx from kms.googleapis.com in us-central1; also we see brief 429s from our client side. No anomalous CPU/memory on our side.

jordan: Impact assessment: writes/signing for token issuance failing intermittently. Autoscaler creating new nodes are stuck booting which exacerbates capacity issues — risk of cascading failures. Read-only operations OK.

rachel: mitigation plan proposal: 1) enable local ephemeral key cache for bootstrapping (software fallback) for non-sensitive tenants behind a feature flag, 2) route signing requests to a healthy region (us-west1) via region-aware proxy, 3) temporarily disable horizontal autoscale for the signing deployment to prevent crash-loop storms.

ops-lead: approve emergency mitigations for up to 3 hours for non-prod and low-risk customers. No software fallback for regulated customers. Track and rotate keys after.

mike: implementing region failover now: updating envoy route table to prefer us-west1 endpoints for kms client, command:```kubectl patch configmap/kms-client-config -n infra --patch '{"data":{"preferred_region":"us-west1"}}' && kubectl rollout restart deploy/signer -n infra```

rachel: also flipping bootstrap cache flag:```POST /api/flags/feature_flags {"signer.bootstrap_cache":true}``` Will monitor success.

pagerduty: Incident pd-9011 acknowledged by rachel. On-call handoff scheduled at 16:35 UTC: rachel -> deepti.

mike: 16:18 UTC update: region failover reduced signing errors by ~70% for traffic routed through proxy. Startup failures down from ~15/hr to ~2/hr. Some clients still routing to original region (legacy routes).

deepthi: I'm opening a support escalation with GCP KMS: case GCP-INC-4321. Attaching traces, packet captures, and full signer client debug logs. Requesting SLA escalation and root cause details.

jordan: Customer comms: drafting banner: "We are investigating elevated signing latency/timeouts impacting a subset of write operations and instance startups. We have enabled regional failover and temporary bootstrapping fallbacks for low-risk tenants. Some customers may see transient errors." Any edits?

ops-lead: add ETA and customer list: include known affected customers (two enterprise tenants) and mention no evidence of key compromise. Severity P1 until stable.

rachel: 16:27 UTC additional mitigation: disabled HPA on signer deployment in infra namespace to stop new pods from spinning up and failing. Command:```kubectl scale hpa signer --replicas=0 -n infra``` Will scale manually after stabilization.

mike: Note: increased signer client timeout to 12s and retry backoff to 8 attempts while failover is active. Pushing rollback toggle so this can be reverted quickly.

pagerduty: handoff at 16:35 UTC executed: deepti now primary on-call owner. rachel remains as backup.

deepthi: 16:44 UTC update from GCP: they have an internal incident in us-central1 impacting KMS control plane; intermittent high latencies and rate-limiting observed. They estimate recover in 30-60 minutes and asked for our logs.

jordan: 16:50 UTC monitoring note: synthetic signer probe at 15s cadence launched. Alert thresholds tightened for p95 and error rate.

rachel: customer banner sent and CS queued personalized messages to the two affected enterprise accounts. No data exposure suspected; this is availability degradation only.

mike: 17:05 UTC: GCP reports partial recovery, errors trending down. We're keeping regional failover and bootstrap cache enabled for rolling verification window.

ops-lead: post-incident action items: 1) implement stronger local key cache with TTL and automatic rotation, 2) build documented region-failover playbook + automation, 3) make signer boot paths resilient to transient KMS errors (graceful degraded mode), 4) tune autoscaler to prefer warm standby instead of aggressive immediate scale-up, 5) add vendor incident correlation to our PagerDuty alerts.

deepthi: I'll own the support follow-up and vendor RCA. rachel to own code changes for bootstrap cache and timeout/backoff tuning. mike to own the failover automation. ops-lead will coordinate postmortem.

oncall-bot: Incident pd-9011 status changed to: monitoring. Revert emergency fallbacks after 18:00 UTC if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
